trust_decision.summary: The Next.js proxy decides that a request is local, and so may reach spawn-capable or host-secret routes, from the client-supplied Host and Origin headers in isLocalRequest. The fix replaces this with a machine-id CLI token, and it also widens which paths the proxy matches.

landing_point.why: The summary names a 'local-only access gate' and 'Host header spoofing'. isLocalRequest is the only function that reads Host for a local-only decision, and the comment above it describes that purpose.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP any method on LOCAL_ONLY_PATHS (/api/mcp/*, /api/cli-tools/cowork-settings, /api/tunnel/tailscale-install, and after the fix /api/oauth/{cursor,kiro}/auto-import)
list of local-only path prefixes; the fix adds GET /api/oauth/cursor/auto-import and /api/oauth/kiro/auto-import (fix.diff:378-379)
ALWAYS_PROTECTED list; the fix adds /api/version/shutdown, /api/version/update and the auto-import routes (fix.diff:343-346)
every /api/* route; changes the allow-list to deny-by-default (fix.diff:411-416)
/v1/*, /v1beta/*, /api/v1/*, /api/v1beta/* LLM API; new gate that allows loopback, CLI token or a valid API key (fix.diff:100-103)
Next.js proxy matcher; at the pinned commit it omits /api/oauth/*, /api/version/*, /v1/* and most of /api/*, so those routes never reach the guard (fix.diff:433-447)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/proxy.js:3-17 (matcher decides which paths ever reach the guard; dashboardGuard.js:162-164 holds a second, dead matcher config)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Host-spoofing report points at isLocalRequest in dashboardGuard.js. The matcher in src/proxy.js looks like Next.js wiring, and a dead duplicate matcher in dashboardGuard.js:162 could convince a solver that the matcher already lives in the guard file. Adding auto-import to LOCAL_ONLY_PATHS without widening the matcher does nothing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Loopback LLM API calls (/v1/*, /api/v1/*) must keep working without an API key. A remote caller with a valid CLI token (x-9r-cli-token) must still reach local-only routes. /api/settings/require-login and the auth/health endpoints must stay public. An over-broad fix (requiring a key everywhere, or blocking every /api/* request) breaks local CLI tools and the login page.

O6_input_shapes: Host header with a loopback name: localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], with or without a port
Origin header absent vs present and loopback
Path prefixes: /v1 and /v1beta vs the rewritten /api/v1 and /api/v1beta
API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' vs 'x-api-key' (Bearer takes precedence)
Local-only path prefix match vs a path the pinned matcher never matches

O7_producer.where: src/proxy.js:3-17 (Next.js reads the matcher config to decide whether the proxy runs at all)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Already behind /api/tunnel auth, and the report names only tailscale-install as the spawn route
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate route file, same app package

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A neighbouring MITM feature that is auth-gated under /api/cli-tools and not described as spawn-capable

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/version/update spawns the detached updater and exits; after the fix it is only ALWAYS_PROTECTED, not local-only, and at the pinned commit it is outside the proxy matcher entirely
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Production-only path, and the fix treats it as an auth concern rather than a locality concern

The /codex/:path* rewrite to /api/v1/responses is not in PUBLIC_PREFIXES, so the new loopback-or-API-key gate never sees it (the proxy matches the path before the rewrite)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The tunnel-dashboard block compares the raw Host header with tunnelUrl/tailscaleUrl; a variant that decides 'local' from Host here would be a second Host-trust site
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same file already makes Host-based routing decisions for the dashboard

O8b_injection_room.sibling: isTunnelRequest re-implements the Host check inside the login handler; a 'skip password on loopback Host' shortcut there would be a second implementation at a distance
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Local-first apps often auto-login on localhost, and this handler already branches on Host

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A handler-level isLocal(Host) re-check inside a spawn-capable route as defence in depth, which the solver would have to fix as well
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Route handlers here already import machineId and do their own gating

O9_family: authentication bypass by spoofing (CWE-290): trusting the client Host/Origin header as proof of locality, plus a proxy matcher coverage gap

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=18, Next.js ^16.1.6, npm; vitest ^4 in tests/package.json; better-sqlite3 native module
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/*.test.js run with vitest and mocked next/server (pattern seen in tests/unit/oauth-cursor-auto-import.test.js). No dashboard-guard test exists at the pinned commit; the fix adds tests/unit/dashboard-guard.test.js. The guard can be unit-tested by calling proxy() with mocked requests.
